cinematic.look: cinematic, shot on ARRI Alexa, 35mm film, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flare
cinematic.lighting: dramatic key light, soft fill, golden hour or moody blue hour
cinematic.color: teal and orange grade, high contrast, filmic

anime.look: 2D anime, Studio Ghibli inspired, hand-drawn, expressive characters
anime.lighting: soft painterly light, warm sunset tones

3d.look: Pixar-style 3D animation, subsurface scattering, soft shaders, stylized proportions
3d.lighting: three-point lighting, soft rim light, ambient occlusion

realistic.look: photorealistic, 8k detail, natural skin and materials, documentary feel

cartoon.look: 2D cartoon, bold outlines, flat colors, exaggerated motion

melodrama.look: emotional TV drama, shot on Sony Venice, 50mm–85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, close-ups of faces and hands
melodrama.lighting: warm soft key light, gentle diffused fill, candle or lamp practical sources, no harsh shadows, golden interior glow
melodrama.color: warm amber and rose grade, lifted shadows, soft contrast, skin tones rich and luminous, desaturated cool backgrounds
